profile.headline: AI at the Edge
profile.summary:
Experienced software developer with strong Systems Programming skills. 
Specialties:
● PCIe Device Driver and Kernel Programming(Linux, MacOS & iOS)
●  Multi-threaded Programming 
● Proficient in C

Interests:
● High Performance computing
● Low latency Software Development
● Multi-threaded Software Development and Debugging
● Hardware Software Co-development
● Linux Kernel Development

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Jose, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: MacOS/iOS Kernel Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
PCIe device driver development for wireless devices on iOS and MacOS platforms
Developing and maintaining transport layer driver of wireless devices for iOS/MacOS kernel
Wifi/BT chip bring up for iOS(iPhone 11, 12, 13) and MacOS platforms(2019+ Mac Platforms)
Bluetooth UEFI device driver development/maintenance for Intel based MAC platforms

Major Projects:
Adapted kernel bypassing for Bluetooth transport layer resulting into significant power savings
Driver level support to keep chip in lowest power state for FindMy feature after phone is powered off

positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Optimized power and performance of Intel Movidius VPU firmware to support Windows Machine Learning(WinML) stack

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:
Linux Kernel PCIe device driver development for Intel Omnipath Host Fabric Interface adapter
UEFI HFI device driver ownership to resolve customer issues while PXE booting over Omni Path
Feature development for user space and kernel components of Linux RDMA stackMajor Projects:

Major Projects:
Developed static address resolution mechanism to significantly reduce fabric management traffic on HPC systems with 1000s of nodes
Developed script for customers to install Intel OmniPath Fabric suite

positions.title: Chrome OS integration Intern
positions.description: Integrated latest platform drivers available on upstream Linux kernel into Chromium OS to enable use of Intel Platforms for Chrome Books

positions.title: Design Engineer
positions.description:
Real time application development on Processor-FPGA heterogeneous platforms
Developed controllers for different Memories, ADC/DACs and high speed sensors to interface them with FPGA along with bare metal driver for processor connected.
Designed FPGA based High Speed Data Acquisition system receiving data from serial interface
and transferring to host processor via PCIE bus
Developed FPGA based real-time correlator to detect proximity using acoustic sensors

company.name: Bit Mapper Integration Technologies Pvt. Ltd

projects.title: User Level Thread Library for real time systems
projects.description: Developed User level thread library in C for Uniprocessor based real time systems with locks having implementation of Basic and Stack based priority inheritance protocols.

projects.title: Dynamic Analysis of Multi-threaded Embedded Software to Expose Atomicity Violation Bugs
projects.description: Developed a framework which predicts memory access interleaving patterns that can violate atomicity using memory accesses to a shared variable and happen before relationship among threads. Framework uses execution replay mechanism to ensure minimum perturbation. Framework also helps to analyze impact of atomicity violation by enforcing predicted interleaving pattern during application execution.

publications.title: Dynamic Analysis of Multi-threaded Embedded Software to Expose Atomicity Violations
